title: Royal Vanilla + LITE
description: Royal Vanilla + LITE is a lightweight Vanilla+ Fabric modpack for Minecraft that focuses on performance and smooth gameplay, with reduced visuals, no shaders, and essential quality-of-life improvements.
body:
# Royal Vanilla + LITE

**Royal Vanilla + LITE** is a lightweight Vanilla+ Fabric modpack for Minecraft (Currently)-**1.21.5**, designed to deliver the core Royal Vanilla + experience with improved performance and reduced visual load.

This version removes shaders and most heavy visual, animation, and particle mods, while keeping gameplay, world generation, datapacks, and resource packs intact.

---

## What You’ll Experience

- **Improved performance** — Optimized for smoother gameplay on lower- to mid-end systems  
- **Vanilla+ gameplay** — Core mods for exploration, building, and quality-of-life  
- **World generation upgrades** — Enhanced terrain, biomes, and structures  
- **Reduced visuals** — Fewer particles and animations compared to the full pack  
- **No shaders included** — Plays great without shader packs  

---

## About the Pack

Royal Vanilla + LITE is ideal for players who want the Vanilla+ experience without heavy graphics or shaders. It is based on the full pack, with visual intensity reduced while keeping content and immersion.

This is part of my **first modpack project**. While tested for stability, minor issues may still occur in rare situations and will be improved over time.

---

## Conclusion

Royal Vanilla + LITE keeps the spirit of Royal Vanilla + while focusing on performance, stability, and accessibility.

---
